      "observations": [
        "All five owned paths and all 711 changed browser-test lines plus both fixtures were read. Collapsed groups require self checked AND all descendants checked for checked=true; any self/descendant choice with an incomplete set is indeterminate. Expanded groups/leaves display the explicit checked property only. Native checkbox state is distinct from TreeView selection; the original row-choice lesson is linked rather than repeated.",
        "A single delegated change listener replaces the per-fill onchange closure. It toggles the clicked model row, cascades only while collapsed, maintains descendant cache properties, evaluates ancestors and repaints visible row instances with fillRow. That source avoids rebuilding the entire tree in this handler; no measured focus preservation, allocation/performance improvement or screen-reader announcement is inferred.",
        "The helper caches all/some/none as row properties and initializes descendants lazily. Upward evaluation reads immediate child choices/caches and stops when the aggregate state is unchanged. These are this handler’s explicit invalidation/update paths, not a promise that arbitrary external model mutations automatically invalidate caches. Current custom TreeDataRow property methods and rowAt contract are separately verified/reused.",
        "Tests directly assert checked/indeterminate/hidden state, own/child model properties, subtree caches, sibling isolation, expanded no-cascade, two/three-level ripple and Space toggles. The uncheckable fixture is top-level and only its hidden checkbox is directly checked. All actual assertion messages are nonempty; several labels omit should but that alone is not a defect.",
        "The test waits for the documented test-only row-buffer event, then two animation frames before initial assertions; each action also waits a frame. Actual comm dispatch guard is checked, while imported spawn/keyboard/native rendering behavior is unpaired and tests were not run. The component, test and fixtures are whole-blob identical at fixed accepted; manifest changes later.",
        "Bounded receiver limit: TreeDataRow.rowCount explicitly permits sparse subclass children, while this checkbox cascade recursively calls every child after only guarding the property update. The dense fixture/current ordinary rows do not demonstrate a sparse-checkbox production path; no crash or reproducible defect is claimed. Nested uncheckable branches and external cache mutation are not direct coverage claims.",
        "Complete primary1243658 coverage is inherited from Root and D303390 creation-to-final/17 old-current actual bodies/four summary Old-New pairs from B, preserving their original scopes/readers/times. I read the relevant actual concerns, responses and phase changes; no independent full discussion reread.",
        "The summary histories change from module helpers plus a generation counter/exported invalidator, to private instance helpers with an evaluated flag, then to three mutually exclusive property caches. Final owned source adopts the private/property-cache design, not the earlier exported invalidation API or a structural-change generation guarantee.",
        "Reviewer recursion/root-path/early-exit concerns are reflected in deep lazy initialization plus shallow upward computation and unchanged-state return. The proposed compact two-line checked/indeterminate assignment appears in actual source; naming row and toggleProperty refinements are scoped review decisions, not universal style rules or a measured complexity/performance guarantee.",
        "Requests for backing data-row properties, intermediate/root state checks, empty and unchecked collapsed parents, deeper trees and synthesized clicks are reflected in actual dense fixtures/assertions. setupTestTree is an actual side effect of the fixture module; a later author keyboard-test statement matches the added Space test. No Try or native/focus/accessibility result was read or run.",
        "The comments-to-info suggestion receives the explicit author response Next time and remains deferred. Primary and early review focus/a11y/data-integrity claims stay attributed reports. Later documentation request/issue creation is not completed knowledge-base publication."
      ],
